objective_for_doctor: Assess and diagnose the patient presenting with weakness and fatigue.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: I’ve been feeling extremely fatigued and weak, especially toward the end of the day, to the point it’s hard to take care of myself. I’ve also noticed some mild double vision. I’ve been traveling and hiking/camping recently and had multiple illnesses in the past.

turns.doctor_question: Do you have any small, raised bumps on your skin that have a tiny indentation or a "dimple" in the center?
turns.patient_answer: I haven’t noticed any small raised bumps with a dimple in the center on my skin. My main issues have been the worsening weakness and fatigue later in the day, along with the mild double vision.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed that you need to urinate more often than usual?
turns.patient_answer: “I haven’t noticed needing to urinate more often than usual.” “My main problems are the worsening fatigue and weakness later in the day, plus the mild double vision.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any difficulty with dressing yourself lately?
turns.patient_answer: “Yes, I’ve been having trouble dressing myself because my weakness and fatigue get so bad later in the day.” “I sometimes have to pause or take longer than usual to finish.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any rashes, bumps, or sores on your skin specifically along the path of the veins in your arms?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any rashes, bumps, or sores along the veins in my arms. I’ve mainly been dealing with the worsening fatigue and weakness toward the end of the day, plus the mild double vision.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any itchiness on your skin?
turns.patient_answer: “I don’t think I’ve had any itchiness on my skin. My symptoms have mostly been the worsening fatigue and weakness toward the end of the day, and the mild double vision.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you experience any pain or cramping in your calf muscles while walking that goes away once you stop and rest?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed calf pain or cramping when I walk that improves after I stop and rest—I haven’t had that kind of symptom. It’s mainly the end-of-day weakness and fatigue with the mild double vision that’s been bothering me.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed if your stools have become unusually pale, light-colored, or clay-colored recently?
turns.patient_answer: “I haven’t noticed my stools becoming unusually pale or clay-colored.” “My main ongoing symptoms are the worsening fatigue and weakness toward the end of the day, along with the mild double vision.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any weakness in your hands, such as difficulty gripping objects or a tendency to drop things more often than usual?
turns.patient_answer: “I have some weakness in my hands—gripping feels harder and I can drop things more easily, especially later in the day.” “It tends to be worse when I’m tired, and I don’t really have other new symptoms.”

turns.doctor_question: During these shaking episodes, are you able to stay conscious and aware of your surroundings, or do you lose consciousness?
turns.patient_answer: “I haven’t had any shaking episodes, so I haven’t lost consciousness. My main problem is the gradual worsening of weakness and fatigue later in the day, along with the mild double vision.”

turns.doctor_question: Are you currently experiencing any pain or discomfort in your abdominal area?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any pain or discomfort in my abdominal area. My symptoms have been mainly the worsening fatigue and weakness toward the end of the day, along with the mild double vision.”
